children: Bookings open for Honda’s new electric scooter and 500cc motorcycle, while the CB350 range gets new colours without mechanical changes

Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India has revealed prices for three new additions to its two-wheeler portfolio — the QC3 electric scooter, CB500 motorcycle and updated CB350 range. Bookings for all five models are now open, with prices effective from September 22.

The Honda QC3 is priced at Rs 1.35 lakh (ex-showroom, New Delhi) and will initially be sold in Delhi, Agra, Cuttack, Surat and Kollam through select Honda RedWing dealerships. It uses a 3.0 kWh battery and has a claimed certified IDC range of 145 km.

The QC3 takes around 2 hours and 40 minutes to charge from 0-80 per cent, while a full charge takes approximately four hours. It also gets a 5-inch TFT display with Honda RoadSync and turn-by-turn navigation, 32-litre storage and a Smart Key.
The electric scooter will be available in four colours — Matt Photon Gray Metallic, Pearl Precious White, Pearl Shallow Blue and Pearl Siren Blue.

Meanwhile, the Honda CB500 starts at Rs 2.75 lakh (ex-showroom, Bengaluru) for the Alloy wheels variant. The Spoke tubeless version costs Rs 2,99,900, while the Spoke tubeless with stripe variant is priced at Rs 3,01,900.

The CB500 is manufactured in India and will be sold through Honda BigWing dealerships across the country. It is powered by a 501cc single-cylinder, air-cooled engine with an oil cooler and gets Honda Selectable Torque Control, an assist and slipper clutch, Honda RoadSync, LED lighting and dual-channel ABS.
The motorcycle is offered in Pearl Deep Ground Grey, Pearl Igneous Black, Matt Steel Silver Metallic and Rebel Red Metallic.
Honda has also revised the CB350 family, comprising the CB350, CB350RS and CB350C, with new colour options. There are no mechanical changes to the motorcycles.

The CB350 continues with its 348.6cc air-cooled engine, while the range retains features such as Honda RoadSync, Honda Selectable Torque Control, an assist and slipper clutch, all-LED lighting and dual-channel ABS.
Prices for the refreshed range start at Rs 1,95,200 (ex-showroom, Bengaluru). Dispatches to Honda BigWing dealerships started on September 21.
QC3 price is ex-showroom New Delhi. CB500 and CB350 range prices are ex-showroom Bengaluru.

Bookings for the three product lines are open with a Rs 5,000 booking amount. The QC3 is initially available through select RedWing dealerships in five cities, while the CB500 and refreshed CB350 range are being offered through Honda BigWing dealerships nationwide.
